page.overview:
Who is Hamlet?

This production of Hamlet occured at a festival at the Delacorte Theater in New York. It was notable for the color-blind casting of James Earl Jones (fresh from his breakthrough film role in The Great White Hope) as Claudius, in spite of a white Hamlet and other family members.
